admission_inventory_policy: Frozen pre-import stored-base inventory; absence requires quarantine, not automatic pronunciation repair or a linguistic invalidity judgment.
attribution: Cantonese Wordnet by Joanna Ut-Seong Sio and Luis Morgado da Costa; source README, canonical citation and original XML notices retained unmodified. See ATTRIBUTION.md.
changes: Downloaded XML and README bytes are unmodified. The full standard license text is copied byte-for-byte from an already retained, verified CC BY4.0 license because the canonical legalcode.txt endpoint returned HTTP403. ATTRIBUTION.md and parser-attested-bases.json are project-generated metadata. No product database or package was changed.
citation: Sio, Joanna Ut-Seong & Morgado da Costa, Luis. (2019). Building the Cantonese Wordnet. In Proceedings of the Tenth Global Wordnet Conference (GWC2019), pp.206-215. Wroclaw, Poland.
combined_adaptation_license_basis: CC BY4.0 source attribution and original license are retained within the separately documented CC BY-SA4.0 combined dictionary adaptation; application code is separate.
excluded: cantown-en English lexicon (5 explanatory lexical entries and 5 empty forms) and any other non-target lexicons
definitions and semantic relations as lookup data
example sentences and companion corpus data
spelling, tone, punctuation or nasal repairs

files.kind: unmodified complete standard CC BY4.0 legal text; license text only, not TypeDuck dictionary data
files.name: LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt

license_declaration: The pinned README License section and XML Lexicon license attribute both declare Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
phrase_translation_policy: Candidate single-character readings must remain direct-lookup-only until separately reviewed; no change to existing ScriptEncoder inputs is authorized by this snapshot.
review_policy: Account for target Cantonese lexical entries and Form occurrences, including empty forms, and record excluded non-target lexicons separately; quarantine malformed, noncanonical, unknown-base, non-Han or text/syllable-unaligned forms with source entry IDs and raw fields. Preserve variant/tone notation without silent interpretation.
scope: Candidate explicit Cantonese/Jyutping Form writtenForm values paired with the Lemma in the same LexicalEntry, only within Lexicon id cantown-yue and language yue. Exclude cantown-en (English) and other non-target lexicons. Full upstream originals retained unchanged. Legacy TSV is not selected because it omits Jyutping forms.
selection_status: Candidate source preparation only; not selected for default import and not independent linguistic approval.

source_snapshot_counts.meaning: Raw source observations, not accepted pair counts, linguistic approval or dictionary contents.

weight_policy: All possible newly selected pairs have weight0 as frequency unknown; do not infer pronunciation frequency, replace existing readings, or inherit whole-text counts.

xml_expectations.selection_policy: Select exactly one Lexicon with both id cantown-yue and language yue; other lexicons are excluded from Cantonese entry/Form accounting and recorded separately.
